Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Gain [gold]Block[/gold] equal to the unblocked damage dealt.
SPIREDUO-PANCAKE_PRESS.title: Pancake Press
SPIREDUO-PANCAKE_PRESS.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Deals double damage if you have at least {Threshold:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
SPIREDUO-ROLLING_MOMENTUM.title: Rolling Momentum
SPIREDUO-ROLLING_MOMENTUM.description:
Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage.
Deals {ExtraDamage:diff()} additional damage for each other Attack you played this turn.
SPIREDUO-TICKLE.title: Tickle
SPIREDUO-CLUMSY_FALL.title: Clumsy Fall
SPIREDUO-CLUMSY_FALL.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to a random enemy.
SPIREDUO-SECOND_HELPING.title: Second Helping
SPIREDUO-SECOND_HELPING.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
[gold]Munch[/gold] 2: Add a copy of this card into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
SPIREDUO-BEAR_SLAM.title: Bear Slam
SPIREDUO-PIGGYBACK_CHARGE.title: Piggyback Charge
SPIREDUO-PIGGYBACK_CHARGE.description:
Deal damage equal to the total [gold]Block[/gold] of you and your allies.{InCombat:
(Deals {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage)|}
SPIREDUO-FLURRY_OF_PAWS.title: Flurry of Paws
SPIREDUO-FLURRY_OF_PAWS.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage {Repeat:diff()} times.
For each hit, gain {BambooPower:diff()} [gold]Bamboo[/gold].
SPIREDUO-BAMBOO_JAVELIN.title: Bamboo Javelin
SPIREDUO-BAMBOO_JAVELIN.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If you have at least {Threshold:diff()} [gold]Bamboo[/gold], deal {Bonus:diff()} more.
SPIREDUO-HUNGRY_SWIPE.title: Hungry Swipe
SPIREDUO-HUNGRY_SWIPE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If you have no [gold]Bamboo[/gold], gain {BambooPower:diff()} [gold]Bamboo[/gold].
SPIREDUO-BAMBOO_STASH.title: Bamboo Stash
SPIREDUO-BELLY_ARMOR.title: Belly Armor
SPIREDUO-PANDA_PILE.title: Panda Pile
SPIREDUO-PANDA_PILE.description: You and an ally each gain {PlatingPower:diff()} [gold]Plating[/gold].
SPIREDUO-IRON_BELLY.title: Iron Belly
SPIREDUO-IRON_BELLY.description:
Gain {CalculatedBlock:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Gains {CalculationExtra:diff()} additional [gold]Block[/gold] for each [gold]Strength[/gold] you have.
SPIREDUO-ENERGY_SNACK.title: Energy Snack
SPIREDUO-BELLY_LAUGH.title: Belly Laugh
SPIREDUO-BRACE_FOR_IMPACT.title: Brace for Impact
SPIREDUO-BRACE_FOR_IMPACT.description:
Gain {CalculatedBlock:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Gains {CalculationExtra:diff()} additional [gold]Block[/gold] for each enemy that intends to attack.
SPIREDUO-HOARDER.title: Bamboo Hoarder
SPIREDUO-HOARDER.description: At the end of your turn, gain {HoarderPower:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold] for each [gold]Bamboo[/gold] you have.
SPIREDUO-BEAR_STANCE.title: Bear Stance
SPIREDUO-BEAR_STANCE.description: Whenever you play an Attack, gain {BearStancePower:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
SPIREDUO-SNACK_ADDICT.title: Snack Addict
SPIREDUO-SNACK_ADDICT.description: Whenever you [gold]Munch[/gold], deal {SnackAddictPower:diff()} damage to a random enemy.
SPIREDUO-PANDA_POWER.title: Panda Power
SPIREDUO-BELLY_BOUNCE.title: Belly Bounce
SPIREDUO-BELLY_BOUNCE.description: Whenever your [gold]Block[/gold] blocks an enemy attack, deal {BellyBouncePower:diff()} damage to the attacker.
SPIREDUO-FEEDING_TIME.title: Feeding Time
SPIREDUO-FEEDING_TIME.description: At the start of your turn, [gold]Munch[/gold] 2: each ally gains {Energy:energyIcons()}.
SPIREDUO-BAMBOO_TORNADO.title: Bamboo Tornado
SPIREDUO-BAMBOO_TORNADO.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies X times.
[gold]Munch[/gold] 2: Hit [blue]1[/blue] more time.
SPIREDUO-CRUSHING_HUG.title: Crushing Hug
SPIREDUO-THOUSAND_PAWS.title: Thousand Paws
SPIREDUO-THOUSAND_PAWS.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage {Repeat:diff()} times.
[gold]Munch[/gold] {BambooPerHit:diff()} for each extra hit, up to {MaxBonusHits:diff()} extra hits.
SPIREDUO-EARTHQUAKE_STOMP.title: Earthquake Stomp
SPIREDUO-EARTHQUAKE_STOMP.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
Apply {WeakPower:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold] to ALL enemies.
SPIREDUO-SNOWBALL.title: Snowball
SPIREDUO-SNOWBALL.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Increase this card's damage by {Increase:diff()} this combat.
[gold]Munch[/gold] 1: Double the increase.
SPIREDUO-PANDA_SMASH.title: Panda Smash
SPIREDUO-PANDA_SMASH.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Costs [blue]1[/blue] less for every {Per:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold] you have.
SPIREDUO-ALL_YOU_CAN_EAT.title: All You Can Eat
SPIREDUO-ALL_YOU_CAN_EAT.description:
[gold]Munch[/gold] all your [gold]Bamboo[/gold].
For every {Per:diff()} eaten, gain {Energy:energyIcons()} and draw {Cards:diff()} card.
SPIREDUO-BIG_AND_FLUFFY.title: Big and Fluffy
SPIREDUO-DOUBLE_UP.title: Double Up
SPIREDUO-CARRY_YOU.title: Carry You
SPIREDUO-CARRY_YOU.description: An ally gains {Energy:energyIcons()} and draws {Cards:diff()} cards.
SPIREDUO-COMFORT_EATING.title: Comfort Eating
SPIREDUO-COMFORT_EATING.description:
[gold]Munch[/gold] all your [gold]Bamboo[/gold].
Heal {Heal:diff()} HP for each one eaten.
SPIREDUO-PANDAMONIUM.title: Pandamonium
SPIREDUO-PANDAMONIUM.description: Play the top {Cards:diff()} cards of your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
SPIREDUO-LUCKY_FALL.title: Lucky Fall
SPIREDUO-SECOND_STOMACH.title: Second Stomach
SPIREDUO-SECOND_STOMACH.description: Each turn, your first [gold]Munch[/gold] costs no [gold]Bamboo[/gold], even if you have none.
SPIREDUO-BAMBOO_SHOOTS.title: Bamboo Shoots
SPIREDUO-BAMBOO_SHOOTS.description: Whenever a card gives you [gold]Block[/gold], gain {BambooShootsPower:diff()} [gold]Bamboo[/gold].
SPIREDUO-FURY_OF_THE_FLUFFY.title: Fury of the Fluffy
SPIREDUO-FURY_OF_THE_FLUFFY.description: Whenever an enemy attack makes you lose HP, gain {FuryOfTheFluffyPower:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold].
SPIREDUO-HULKING_PAWS.title: Hulking Paws
SPIREDUO-PARTNER_IN_CRIME.title: Partner in Crime
SPIREDUO-PARTNER_IN_CRIME.description: Whenever an ally plays an Attack, deal {PartnerInCrimePower:diff()} damage to a random enemy.
SPIREDUO-TASTE_TEST.title: Taste Test
SPIREDUO-SOFT_LANDING.title: Soft Landing
SPIREDUO-ROLL_START.title: Roll Start
SPIREDUO-PACKED_LUNCH.title: Packed Lunch
SPIREDUO-SECOND_COURSE.title: Second Course
SPIREDUO-SECOND_COURSE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Consume [gold]Full[/gold] and [gold]Munch[/gold] 2: deal it again.
SPIREDUO-DIGEST.title: Digest
SPIREDUO-COUNTER_CURL.title: Counter Curl
SPIREDUO-COUNTER_CURL.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
The next enemy Attack blocked by your Block deals {CounterCurlPower:diff()} damage to all enemies.
SPIREDUO-BELLY_FORTRESS.title: Belly Fortress
SPIREDUO-BELLY_FORTRESS.description: Whenever your Block decreases before your turn ends, deal {BellyFortressPower:diff()} damage to a random enemy.
SPIREDUO-PAW_PRACTICE.title: Paw Practice
SPIREDUO-TUCK_AND_ROLL.title: Tuck and Roll
SPIREDUO-DOWNHILL.title: Downhill
SPIREDUO-DOWNHILL.description: Spend all [gold]Roll[/gold]. Deal {Damage:diff()} plus {PerRoll:diff()} per Roll damage {Repeat:diff()} times.
SPIREDUO-BOTTOMLESS_BUFFET.title: Bottomless Buffet
SPIREDUO-BOTTOMLESS_BUFFET.description: Your first {BottomlessBuffetPower:diff()} Munches cost 1 less Bamboo (minimum 1). Whenever you Munch 3 or more Bamboo, gain {BottomlessBuffetPower:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold].
SPIREDUO-RETURN_TO_SENDER.title: Return to Sender
SPIREDUO-RETURN_TO_SENDER.description: Whenever you take unblocked damage, gain [gold]Block[/gold] equal to {ReturnToSenderPower:diff()}% of it.
SPIREDUO-PROTEIN_SHAKE.title: Protein Shake
SPIREDUO-PROTEIN_SHAKE.description: Gain {StrengthPower:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold]. If you have not Munched this turn, gain {NoMunchBonus:diff()} more.
SPIREDUO-MAUL_RHYTHM.title: Maul Rhythm
SPIREDUO-MAUL_RHYTHM.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage {Repeat:diff()} times. If you have Strength, apply {WeakPower:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold].
SPIREDUO-ALPHA_PANDA.title: Alpha Panda
SPIREDUO-ALPHA_PANDA.description: Whenever you gain [gold]Strength[/gold], gain {AlphaPandaPower:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold] next turn.
SPIREDUO-PINBALL_PANDA.title: Pinball Panda
SPIREDUO-PINBALL_PANDA.description: Spend all [gold]Roll[/gold]. Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies, plus one hit for every 2 Roll.
SPIREDUO-ROLLING_FEAST.title: Rolling Feast
SPIREDUO-SAVE_FOR_LATER.selectionScreenP: Choose a card to gain Retain.
SPIREDUO-ROLL_BACK.selectionScreenPrompt: Choose a card to put on top of your Draw Pile.
SPIREDUO-NEAT_PILE.selectionScreenPrompt: Choose a card to put on top of your Draw Pile.
